waves.notes: Bounded delete(policy, sha) (index first then bin, link_info before every removal, symlinks and hard links refused untouched, half-present objects handled) and reclaim_expired(policy, now_ms, max_objects) with a receipt (examined, removed, refused, bytes_freed, truncated; expiry re-read before each delete; malformed indexes reported, not deleted). Process defect: the 6c packet had scoped T4 below the design safety requirement and recorded the omission as a limit.

waves.mutants: 6/6 worker (counter never increments, pause unreachable, history unbounded, RunNow reschedules, max_objects ignored, Resume does not reset) plus 1 integrator re-observation
waves.notes: telegram_media_janitor: supervised OTP actor (child_spec_named, restart under one_for_one proven) running reclaim_expired once per bounded cadence with a bounded history, GetSnapshot and RunNow, single timer chain, Jidoka pause after three consecutive whole-run errors until Resume. A deleted store base is an empty store by the store law, so the error path is provoked by an unlistable base. Closes the media lifecycle at source; production placement is deployment configuration.

waves.canonicals_answering: 77/77 (unchanged); captioned media now answers a typed media reply
waves.mutants: 4/4 integrator (guard caption fallback removed; poll never carries media; intake Stored not ok; malformed stored media decodes silently)
waves.notes: Media intake at ingress: the guard accepts message.caption as the command text when message.text is absent and names bare media as media_without_caption; the stored input row carries the declared media reference as an optional top-level field (encode_input_verdict_with_media, decode_input_media; pre-6h rows unchanged); commit_prefix_media keyed by update id with commit_prefix delegating; the service collects references at poll time (poll_media_references) and, at dispatch, answers the typed media reply (telegram_media_intake: download, inspect, store; backend_unavailable without a transport, denied on any refusal, ok only when stored under the recomputed digest; caption directive reported, never executed). MediaConfiguration.transport added; configure_media takes it. Security journey SEC-J3/S1 flips from tombstone to MediaAccepted and S1b records the bare-media tombstone.

waves.canonicals_answering: 77/77 (unchanged); media intake now has a real HTTP transport
waves.mutants: 3/3 integrator (URL prefix check dropped; fetch bound ignored; getFile path validation dropped), run with hackney started
waves.notes: HTTP media transport: telegram_http_client gains get_file (Bot API getFile, bounded, file_path validated, no URL in errors) and fetch_file_bytes (one bounded GET, at most the FFI ceiling of 10 MiB, oversize is an error never a truncation); telegram_media_transport.from_http builds the download Transport, accepting only the api.telegram.org prefix with the configured token and fetching from the configured base host (the only host contacted). The Erlang HTTP fixture serves set_file, getFile and /file/bot<token>/<path>. Intake through the real transport against the fixture stores the bytes under their sha256. Environment note: fixture-backed tests need hackney started; the gleam test runner does it, a bare erl eunit call does not (explains the nine baseline slice1 fixture failures under erl).

waves.canonicals_answering: 77/77 (unchanged); every per-kind media cap is now fetchable
waves.mutants: 3/3 integrator (reader never advances; 416 past the end as error; chunk bound not clamped, which survived until a clamp law test was added)
waves.notes: Ranged media fetch: telegram_http_client.fetch_file_range (Range requests of 4 MiB, 206 with Content-Range parsed and cross-checked, 200 accepted only from offset zero within one chunk, 416 past the end is end of body) and parse_content_range; telegram_media_transport.open_stream returns a ranged reader with an absolute stream deadline, so the download adapter enforces the per-kind cap across chunks and the 10 MiB single-read ceiling is gone; the fixture honours a single byte range (206, Content-Range, 416) and can omit file_size. Proven: a 12 MiB document streams through the real transport and is stored under its digest; a 12 MiB photo with undeclared size is aborted at the photo cap across chunks with nothing stored.

waves.canonicals_answering: 77/77 (unchanged); captioned media can no longer reach the specialised arms
waves.mutants: 3/3 integrator (media gate removed; forwarding never detected; allowlist skipped before media naming)
waves.notes: Advisory R2 review of the command surface (REQUEST_CHANGES, 16 findings) answered: C-01 specialized_dispatch returns RegularDispatch whenever the stored row carries or malforms a media reference; C-02 forwarded, automatically forwarded and via-bot messages refused as forwarded_not_supported; C-10 allowlist checked before any media naming (stranger bare photo is unauthorized); C-03 media_reply checks the window before the chain and reports the chain outcome as it happened; C-04 and C-06 denied, unknown and fallthrough replies carry an INV-TGJ-04 status and observation_failed maps to backend_unavailable with the label kept as the reason; C-08 unknown-directive echo bounded to 64 bytes; C-14 security coverage counts only behavioural steps; C-15 the plain-message law asserts adapter preview statuses and a closed service-owned set over five argument shapes; INV-TGJ-06 records the media effect, the caption precedence and the forwarded refusal. Process defect: C-01 was introduced by this session in wave 6h and normalised by an e2e whose caption classified to the regular arm; found by an independent reviewer with the full surface.

waves.canonicals_answering: 77/77 (unchanged); Mini App pages now name their absence

waves.notes: Advisory R2 review of the Mini App (APPROVE_WITH_CHANGES, 18 findings) answered on the server side: A-01 every Unavailable observation renders a closed-enum reason_code (immune_actor_not_running reachable; unknown reasons collapse to unavailable_unspecified; raw strings never render); A-02 the verification record is rendered expired and stale with zero passes when its own record_expires_at_ms has passed, whatever the worker wrote; A-06 the vm logger target none is refused; A-07 an enqueue failure with no receipt answers 503 sa_plan_unavailable instead of 404. Residuals: A-03 pre-actor authorization (config lives in the actor), A-04 action initData max_age, A-05 derived secret only, A-08 unreachable identity recheck, A-10 zenoh observed_at, A-11 pre-auth probing, A-12 second parser, A-13 deadline after observer, A-14 long task ids, A-15 hard-coded paths and SHAs, FMEA freshness recomputation, browser behaviour.
